description: Check whether a quotation appears word for word in a stored document (or one version of it), after normalizing whitespace, typographic quotes and dashes, [T]he-style alterations, amendment marks, and case. Use it before relying on a quotation.

id.description: The document id (or any written form of one).
id.title: Id

quote.description: The quotation to check, at least 12 characters.
quote.title: Quote

version.description: A version id to check; default the current version, then earlier ones.
version.title: Version

name: verify_quote
title: Check a quotation
